//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the modal component (pa-modal). NEUTRAL scenarios + the GOLDEN markup core blesses. Scope is the single modal component that keen `modal/1` and svelte `Modal.svelte` render. Goldens encode the canonical shape from packages/core/snippets/modals.html: root .pa-modal[ --variant / --banded / --top ] > .pa-modal__backdrop + .pa-modal__container[ --size ] > (.pa-modal__header > .pa-modal__title + close pa-btn) + .pa-modal__body[ --scrollable ] + (.pa-modal__footer). See ../README.md and card.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.variant: role colour on the ROOT (primary|success|warning|danger|info) — emits pa-modal--{variant}; colours the header via a descendant selector. There is NO pa-modal__header--{variant}. --info has no solid-header rule (band-only), but the class exists and is valid, so it's kept in the enum; pair it with banded for colour.
propsVocabulary.banded: boolean — pa-modal--banded; header AND footer wear the role colour as filled bands (needs a band role variant: success/warning/danger/info).
propsVocabulary.top: boolean — pa-modal--top; align the dialog near the top (5vh) instead of centred.
propsVocabulary.size: container size on __container (sm|lg|xl|xxl|fw) — emits pa-modal__container--{size}. md is the DEFAULT and emits NO class (a bare .pa-modal__container IS medium).
propsVocabulary.scrollable: boolean — pa-modal__body--scrollable; explicit shorter body max-height (60vh).
propsVocabulary.static: boolean — BEHAVIOURAL JS hook only. There is NO .pa-modal--static CSS rule (confirmed absent from dist/css/main.css); it exists purely so the example JS skips Esc + backdrop dismissal. The two wrappers DIVERGE on it (keen emits the class, svelte deliberately omits it), so no scenario exercises it — see goldenConventions.
propsVocabulary.showClose: boolean — whether the header close button (pa-btn pa-btn--icon-only ...) is rendered. Default true.
propsVocabulary.title: header title text, rendered as <h3 class="pa-modal__title">.
propsVocabulary.titleIcon: optional leading severity glyph name — emits followed by a space before the title text (matches core's severity/banded headers).

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the snippet shape PLUS the a11y conventions BOTH wrappers carry on the SSR close button: aria-label="Close" on the <button>, and aria-hidden="true" on the inner <span class="pa-icon pa-icon--x">. (Both wrappers resolve their close-label i18n key to the literal "Close"; no type="button" is emitted by either, matching the snippet.) The close button uses standard pa-btn classes — pa-btn--secondary on a plain header, pa-btn--light when the header wears a role colour (variant or banded band) so the × reads against the fill — mirroring the snippet; this is the ONE place the two wrappers' close-class logic must agree, so every banded scenario is paired with a role variant (svelte keys --light off `variant || isBanded`, keen off `variant`, so they agree only when a variant is present). pa-modal--show is OMITTED from every golden: it is a JS-toggled state class (cssStateClasses) — svelte would emit it from `show=true` but keen adds it via phx-mounted at runtime, never in SSR markup, so `show` is left unmapped/false on both. Every scenario supplies a `body` because keen's inner_block is required (always renders __body) while svelte renders __body only when children exist — a shared golden needs both to emit it. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-modal(--|__)'). `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-modal modifier class). variant keeps 'info' because .pa-modal--info exists in the CSS (as a band role) even though it has no solid-header rule.

static.note: Behavioural JS hook; NO CSS rule and no pa-modal--static in main.css. Wrappers diverge (keen emits the class, svelte omits it), so this is mapped-but-not-exercised: declared in both maps for axis-2, left out of every golden to avoid a spurious compare diff.

showClose.note: structural — toggles the header close button (standard pa-btn, no pa-modal__* class). Default true.

title.note: structural — <h3 class="pa-modal__title">. The pa-modal__title element is exercised by the header scenarios.

titleIcon.note: structural — emits <span class="pa-icon pa-icon--{name}"> inside the title (foreign pa-icon class, owned by the icon system, not a pa-modal element).

id.note: Root id="..." — the open/close JS target the core snippet carries (openModal/closeModal(id)). BOTH goldens include it. keen's modal/1 has `id` REQUIRED and always renders `id={@id}`. svelte's Modal.svelte originally had NO id prop; an optional `id` prop (rendered `{id}` on the root, omitted when unset) was added in this slice so the wrapper can emit the snippet's root id — a minimal, principled fix (also enables aria-labelledby / external addressing), see report. Both maps now declare it.

cssStateClasses.//: pa-modal--* classes toggled by runtime JS (never hand-authored at SSR), so no feature produces them; the axis-1 reverse check counts them as claimed.
cssStateClasses.pa-modal--show: Open/visible state (display:flex). Toggled by openModal/closeModal JS (svelte: `show` prop; keen: JS.add_class via phx-mounted). Never part of the blessed SSR markup a shared golden can assert — svelte emits it only when show=true, keen only after mount.
